description: Baseline: locked real-config soak benchmark and correctness gates

asi.hypothesis: Establish stable real-config CPU baseline while preserving 90 ms cadence and visual behavior.
asi.workload: Three 3-second Snacks dashboard soaks after 1-second warmup; median CPU; default grudge_axe glitch; 10-13 FPS gate.
asi.anti_cheat: Benchmark and checks locked; cadence, timer cleanup, generation, and lifecycle behavior enforced.
asi.finding: Baseline CPU 4.975%; full redraw p95 7.122 ms; section serialization 798.5 µs and 146.1 KiB/call.

description: Cache filtered color results across animation frames

asi.hypothesis: Source/filter color pairs repeat across frames; memoizing exact tint results removes repeated RGB parsing, luminance math, and formatting without changing output.
asi.finding: CPU improved 16.4%; section mean fell from 798.5 µs to 203.2 µs. Allocation stayed ~146 KiB because section tables/strings still rebuild. Full-update p95 rose, likely soak noise or GC variance; cadence unchanged.
asi.next_action: Target section table/string reconstruction while preserving exact frame content and full redraw cadence.
asi.anti_cheat: Exact color function output cached by inputs; no frame skipping, cadence change, or benchmark edit.

description: Cache highlight names by filtered color and glow

asi.hypothesis: Each segment rebuilds the same highlight-name string; caching exact color/glow to name mappings removes repeated concatenation and lookup work.
asi.finding: Section mean fell another 38.4% from 203.2 µs to 125.1 µs. Primary CPU improved only 0.8% versus prior keep, likely near noise; redraw p95 recovered somewhat. Allocation metric unchanged, implying table/text construction now dominates.
asi.next_action: Measure a structural reduction in section text table/string allocation; avoid more tiny lookup tweaks.
asi.anti_cheat: Highlight semantics and names unchanged; cadence and full Snacks redraw preserved.
